target.title: chore(android): update dependencies and compile with API 37
target.body:
Supersedes #100452.

## What Problem This Solves

The current Android dependency updates cannot build because AndroidX Core 1.19 and Lifecycle 2.11 require compilation against API 37, while the app and hosted workflows still compile against API 36. The original Dependabot PR consequently fails both flavor tests and the Android build job.

## Why This Change Was Made

This keeps the complete dependency update, moves the app and benchmark modules to `compileSdk = 37`, and installs the currently published `platforms;android-37.0` package in both CI and release workflows. `targetSdk` remains 36 so Android 17 runtime behavior stays a separate migration; the API 37 `DnsResolver(Context, Looper)` constructor is selected only on API 37+, with the existing singleton retained below it.

The Android CI build lane now assembles and lints both Play and third-party variants and compiles the benchmark target. Workflow guard tests lock those tasks and the CI/release SDK package to the Gradle compile SDK.

## User Impact

Android builds can consume the updated Compose, AndroidX, CommonMark, Kotest, JUnit, OkHttp, and Gradle versions without opting users into Android 17 target-SDK behavior. Release builds and pull-request CI use the same API 37 platform package.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwxawmtbg128ywjv5gnd3mhm` (`quick-krill`) installed `platforms;android-37.0` and completed both `:app:testPlayDebugUnitTest` and `:app:testThirdPartyDebugUnitTest`.
- The same hosted run completed `:app:assemblePlayDebug`, `:app:assembleThirdPartyDebug`, `:app:lintPlayDebug`, `:app:lintThirdPartyDebug`, and `:benchmark:assembleDebug`.
- `:app:ktlintCheck` and `:benchmark:ktlintCheck` passed.
- `pnpm test test/scripts/ci-workflow-guards.test.ts`: 36 tests passed.
- `pnpm check:workflows` passed, including actionlint and zizmor.
- `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed after refreshing the generated source-line inventory.
- `pnpm check:changed` passed on the hosted Testbox.
- `validateThirdPartyLicenseAssets` passed; the update introduces no new dependency or license families.
- Fresh full-branch autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
- GitHub Actions exact head `77acfcb9753512f7eeb2fe5939c57a9c77773598`: 79 passed, 13 intentionally skipped, 0 pending or failed after one transient Play-test retry.
